interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to The Timeline's team-visible workspace memory. One general skill teaches agents how to choose MCP tools, expand source evidence, distinguish current state from activity, and adapt cited answers to the request. Standard keys are read-only; an admin-enabled agent key may create reviewable proposals and call enabled team-shared tools.
